notes.title: The Nick: Chapter 1 is out! What's next?
notes.content:
Today, we have released our debut game - The Nick! Wow, we are so excited! We can’t wait to hear what you think. So go ahead and play if you haven’t already!

This is just the beginning of an incredible adventure with deep storytelling and innovative gameplay mechanics. But you can experience it right now for free—available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026070/The_Nick_Chapter_1_DEMO/

[h2]Development Plans for Chapter 1[/h2]

We are a fully independent and relatively small team. During the development of Chapter 1, we had no funding or external support, so we truly gave it our all. And we made it! But we already have a lot of improvements in mind to enhance the overall experience from Chapter 1 onward.

Every week, we will release patch notes with fixes based on your feedback. After that, we’ll launch a final, technically and aesthetically polished version of the chapter, adding more effects, dialogues, and immersive elements! This will be our primary focus for the first month after release.

[previewyoutube=I7x1rVGbDCM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Future Chapters & Chapter 2[/h2]

We are actively working on The Nick! Here’s the list of all chapters that will be available in the full version:

[list]
[*] The Nick: Chapter 1 - Forest Mansion - AVAILABLE NOW;
[*] The Nick: Chapter 2 - Filthy Leaks - Coming soon, before the rest;
[*] The Nick: Chapter 3 - Depths of Mind;
[*] The Nick: Chapter 4 - The Last Nightmare (to be released alongside Depths of the Mind).
[/list]

We will release Chapter 2 before the full version as a paid expansion. However, if you purchase the full game, you won’t need to pay again for the later chapters—they will be included as they launch. More details are available in The Nick support center.

[h2]What to Expect in the Next Chapter[/h2]

We assure you — this adventure is only getting crazier! Chapter 2 will be significantly more intense than Chapter 1, with a stronger focus on the main story, character development, and new plot twists. It is planned to be three times longer in gameplay than the previous chapter.

[list]
[*] [b]New Location:[/b] You will gain access to the second floor of the mansion... What secrets lie within?
[*] [b]Deeper Storyline:[/b] Nick will dig deeper into the past events of the mansion while continuing to search for an escape. You will uncover much more about the core narrative—there’s a lot to discover!
[*] [b]New and Familiar Characters[/b]: Many new faces await! You will meet both major and minor residents of the mansion. Expect more quests, more side stories, and more drama. Plus, you’ll learn even more about the characters you already met in Chapter 1—more details, more intrigue, and unexpected twists!
[*] [b]Unique Mechanics:[/b] An expanded combat system with new abilities, and we promise... a TRUE META-HORROR EXPERIENCE.
[*] [strike]Void: No data available.[/strike]
[/list]


Thank you for your interest in our story. We are doing everything we can to deliver a truly unique experience and tell this dark and sorrowful tale of The Nick.

We can’t wait to hear your feedback! 💜


[i]Flat Reality Team[/i]

notes.title: Pumpkins, skulls, and the release date! - The Nick Spooktober Digest
notes.content:
[i]Boo! Scared? Don't be scared. I'm a friend.[/i]

Whooaaahhh we haven't seen each other in forever! Hello everyone!!!

So much has happened. Today we're going to briefly review all the most important events, as well as present plans for the future. We have a lot to share today on Halloween!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100835/731f4318e98367cc2e640450073908ef428135f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Trailer and release date[/h2]
Of the hottest stuff, we've released a release trailer for the soon-to-be-released The Nick: Chapter 1. It's 3 mins long dynamic cinematic video showing the most important features of the game. 
Please just watch this if you haven't seen it yet. We are waiting for your reaction in the comments, because communication with the audience is a priority for us (otherwise who would write all these digests...). You can do it in as many as 3 languages - all of which The Nick will support. 
Have a nice view!

[b]Chapter 1 comes out March 11, 2025 on Steam for free. FREE, YES![/b]
We really want everyone to get a taste of a game in a genre as rare as meta horror, so we invite you to start the adventure for free. If you like it, you'll be able to dive into the remaining few chapters at a democratic price and appreciate the edgy thriller universe of The Nick.
[previewyoutube=I7x1rVGbDCM;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Roadmap of the next chapters[/h2]
This is an important point as we're talking about the future of the game, which is coming out in just a few months.
As we've already boasted, Chapter 1 will be free to play. Forever. Everyone, even 100 years from now, will be able to download The Nick: Chapter 1 for free and enjoy a huge mansion. We're also working on a way for players to save their progress on different platforms around the game.
Chapter 2 will be released a little later. It will be a much bigger adventure taking place on the 2nd floor of the mansion. It's too early to reveal any details, but we're sure it will be much bigger than Chapter 1. We will be releasing this for a fee. It will be a spiffy real adventure longer than the previous chapter by several times!
Chapters 3&4 will be released together. This will be immediately available to those who bought Chapter 2. So you will only have to pay once to play The Nick past Chapter 1.
As for future support. We've discussed this in the team many times and we've come to the conclusion that we're more than happy to continue working on the universe, including updates, holidays and DLC, if the game is welcomed by you, the players. We have really fallen in love with The Nick and are excited to keep working on it!


[h2]Development progress[/h2]
It's kind of weird to say this, but we're almost done on Chapter 1. We are now in the middle of closed testing and debugging, as well as final polishing before release. More time now is taken up by the production cycle - there's a lot to tell about the game! So if you have people who are interested in any kind of games at all (even a game of slash during a boring office day), you can share with them that you're following The Nick. If they start twisting the title and saying “The Nock,” then..... it's up to you to decide what to do next, we won't stop you.

In addition, we are smoothly beginning work on Chapter 2. After the release of Chapter 1, we will start working on all chapters at once to maximize the productivity of the development team.


[h2]Trick or treat![/h2]
Happy Halloween!🎃

The entire development team congratulates you and was insanely excited to see the premiere of the game's trailer during such a spooky week! It was insanely sweet and we appreciated the interest. Now we're going to go decorate our social media and develop a terrifying scary horror game. Share with us how you're spending this holiday!


[h2]Studio news[/h2]
What about us, Flat Reality Game Studio. Uh, okay, well, thanks for asking! Anything else..?
We recently completely revamped our website in a rethinking of our operations. We are now a gaming company gearing up for a very diverse range of work in the gaming industry. We will keep our passion for experimentation and something new, so be sure to check out our site and stay tuned!

These months are going to be busy with posts and content from us. We have a lot of plans that won't take too long to finalize. Please keep an eye on our socials.



[i]*The crunching sound of bones....[/i]


Thank you for reading our newsletter! They'll be coming out here from now on, so feel free to check out Steam more often for this one. Although we won't be disappearing anywhere for a long time anytime soon, the next newsletter will probably be waiting for your eyes on the eve of winter holidays.

See you!
